name: reader
title: Reader
description: Read a web page or article in a clean view, and turn what it says into notes and tasks: summarize, simplify, translate, list action items or ask a question about it.

read_url.description: Fetch a web page through Octipus and return it as a clean article: title, byline, site, reading time and text

reader_action.description: Summarize, simplify, translate, list the action items of, or answer a question about an article (a URL or its text)

save_note.description: Save an article, or what the reader made of it, as a note of the user's

create_tasks.description: Add action items to the user's to-do list, filed under Reading and linked to the article
